source_text:
Ὁ θερίζων μισθὸν λαμβάνει καὶ συνάγει καρπὸν εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον, ἵνα ὁ σπείρων ὁμοῦ χαίρῃ καὶ ὁ θερίζων.

ζητητέον τίς ὁ μισθὸς τοῦ θερίζοντος καὶ τίς ὁ καρπὸς ὁ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον συναγόμενος.
pass_a_gloss: The one harvesting receives a wage and gathers fruit into eternal life, in order that the one sowing together may rejoice and the one harvesting. One must inquire what the wage of the one harvesting is and what the fruit being gathered into eternal life is.
pass_b_english: [[“The reaper receives wages and gathers fruit for eternal life, so that the sower and reaper may rejoice together.” >> Bible:John 4:36]]
Ask what the reaper’s wage is, and what fruit is gathered for eternal life.
